name: cf-workers-status-page
description: Self-hosted uptime monitoring and status page on Cloudflare Workers and Durable Objects

UPLOADS.description: R2 bucket for the logos and favicons uploaded in the admin UI. R2 must be enabled on the account (Dashboard → R2) first, or the deploy fails; without R2, remove `r2_buckets` from `wrangler.jsonc` and the rest works as before. Use a name that no other cf-workers-status-page instance in this account uses. See the README, [Uploaded images and colours](https://github.com/naosystem-jp/cf-workers-status-page#uploaded-images).

NOTIFICATION_KEYS.description: Encrypts the webhook URLs and other secrets of notification targets. Generate a key with `echo "k1:$(openssl rand -base64 32)"` and paste the whole output (`k1:` and 44 characters). **Keep a copy**: without it, saved targets cannot be decrypted. See the README, [Secrets](https://github.com/naosystem-jp/cf-workers-status-page#secrets).

DB.description: Incidents, maintenance, page appearance and notification targets. The Worker creates its tables itself. Use a name that no other cf-workers-status-page instance in this account uses: two instances must not share it.

NOTIFICATIONS.description: Queue that delivers notifications. Use a name that no other instance in this account uses, and that does **not** end in `-dlq`.

NOTIFICATIONS_DLQ.description: Dead letter queue of the notification queue. Its name **must** end in `-dlq`: the Worker recognises it by that. If you rename either queue, `wrangler.jsonc` must name the same queues under `queues.consumers` (`queue`, `dead_letter_queue`).
